body.title: docs(cmd): clarify dry-run flag helper doc comments
body.body:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Improves the Go doc comments for the `--dry-run` flag helpers in `pkg/cmd/helpers.go`. The existing comment on `cmdGetDryRunFlagStrategy` has an unbalanced backtick and does not start with the function name, and `addDryRunFlag` had no doc comment. This documents the accepted values, the deprecated legacy forms, and the `helm template` special case.

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

Comment-only change; no code is modified.

**If applicable**:
- [ ] this PR contains user facing changes (the `docs needed` label should be applied if so)
- [ ] this PR contains unit tests
- [ ] this PR has been tested for backwards compatibility

commit.message:
docs(cmd): clarify dry-run flag helper doc comments

Signed-off-by: Swift <theycallmeswift@gmail.com>

+// addDryRunFlag registers the --dry-run flag on cmd. The flag accepts "none",

+// cmdGetDryRunFlagStrategy determines the action.DryRunStrategy from the
+// `--dry-run=<value>` flag (or its absence).

+// Legacy usage of the flag (boolean values, and `--dry-run` without a value) is
+// still supported, but a deprecation warning is logged. When isTemplate is true,
+// a value that would disable the dry run is rejected, since `helm template`
+// never contacts the cluster.
